notes.title: Patch Notes (Halloween Update)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

RED got an update.

PATCH NOTES: 

changelog
changes to blinking red outline on damage
radio battery lasts significantly longer
made changes to certain maps that would allow monsters to be blocked off in unintended ways
application icon updated
computer reply options visually changed to convey interaction better
computer mouse now turns red when hovering over an interactive object, conveying buttons to the player better.
Tab button now quickly opens the inventory
certain puzzle now has more clues associated with it
pause menu can now be interacted with using the mouse


- RED DEV TEAM

notes.title: Post Launch Update 2
notes.content:
Thank you, everyone, for your continued support. 

We are working on an update that is scheduled to launch next week. 

This patch will be addressing: pick up items, inventory and menu, damage indicator, informative text and tutorials, investigation gameplay clarity, text font size, and the radio's battery life. 

If you would like more details on the patch, feel free to email us - info@boldergames.com


-RED DEV TEAM

notes.title: Post Launch Update 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thanks to you RED has made it to #2 for new releases on categories Indie and VR. 

We have received so many kind words and a ton of great feedback.

Our dev team currently has an update ready that addresses a few things including:
- Damage indicators
- Text dialogue
- Ending screen

This update will be sent to steam at the end of the day today. 

Best,
RED DEV TEAM
